stage1.impression: This reads as a home-cinema showroom render, not a photograph of a specific bar. The fir-lined niche with its two clear-cabinet speakers is the one designed moment. The rest is flat, noisy dark walls, blobby velvet tubs, a large lilac-white projection screen that pulls the eye away from the altar, and Orb lamps glowing cold white like ping-pong balls. At 1:1 the speakers look grey and clear rather than smoked, the plinth tops carry a hot white band that reads as an LED strip, the horn reflections are smeared by the denoiser, and no concrete, beam or steel texture can be seen. A magazine would see it as a generic listening lounge, not a place it would run.

blocking_9: The shell must read as board-formed concrete, Douglas fir beams and blackened steel at 1:1 (formwork grain, tie holes, beam checks); the walls and ceiling now read as flat, noisy dark paint
The projection screen must drop to a dim, warm secondary practical and stop competing with the altar (region [0,170,265,425] median well under the speakers' median)
The smoked tint of the speakers and Orbs must read as the frame's only colour; they now read as neutral grey-clear and cool white
The foreground must contain no cut-off, overlit furniture at the frame edges, and the frame needs visible signs of life (a glass, a record out, a coat)
No clipped white edges on the plinths and no denoiser smear in the acrylic reflections
It must read as a specific place (concrete shell, step up into the zone, beams) rather than a generic cinema room

defects.what: Projection screen too bright and cool-lilac (median 127, b 134 > g 124); the brightest large area in the frame competes with the hero
Orb lamp glows cool white (b 167 > r 157), reads as a plain white globe, not smoked acrylic with a frosted liner
Right Orb is the same: a white globe cut by the frame edge
Third Orb cut off at the bottom-left corner
Nearest oak table is overlit, pinkish and flat (median 147), cut by the frame edge, with no grain
Foreground tub chair back crushed to a dark blob (median 17), with no velvet texture
Hot white band on the top edge of the left plinth (clip 1.79%) reads as an LED strip
Same hot band on the right plinth top
Sleeve leaning on the plinth reads as a flat beige card with no print or edge
Horn reflections are smeared and blotchy (denoiser smear)
Speaker cabinet reads as clear or grey glass with a white woofer; the smoked tint is weak (r82 g68 b69)
Ceiling and upper walls read as dark noisy paint; no Douglas fir beams or concrete read (median 18)
Right wall is flat and textureless (lum_range 24); it does not read as concrete
Floor is an even dull brown with no polish or reflections of the practicals

changes.problem: The projection screen is the brightest large area and pulls the eye from the altar.

evidence.measured: lum_median 127.1, b_median 134 > g 124 (cool), against the speaker's 71

change.setting: the room's glowing surfaces: the screens' images

changes.expected: The screen sits at about half the speaker's brightness and reads as a dim projection in a dark room.

changes.problem: The shell reads as flat dark paint; no board-formed concrete or beam texture reads.

change.to: a lighter warm grey (about #8A8378 albedo), slight sheen (roughness about 0.6), stronger board-grain and tie-hole bump so the grazing Dome light reveals it

changes.expected: The walls show formwork grain under the grazing light and warm up under 2400 K.

changes.problem: Cut-off, overlit furniture and Orbs at the left and bottom edges make the frame feel accidental and crowded at the corners.

evidence.measured: lum_median 147 on the nearest table, cut by the frame edge; an Orb cut at [0,740,100,800]

change.to: [12.6, 1.6, 1.15] m (seated eye height), 32 mm, target [16.6, 3.2, 1.0]; one tub chair and table whole in the lower foreground

changes.expected: A seated view centred on the altar with one complete chair and Orb in the foreground and no cut-off objects at the edges.

changes.problem: The Orbs glow cool white and read as globes, not tinted acrylic.

change.setting: the Orbs: liner glow, and how rough the frosted acrylic is
change.to: glow 0.0012, with the liner's emission at 2200 K and the frosted roughness raised so the smoked shell tints it

changes.expected: The Orbs read as a warm, smoked glow with darker rims, not white spheres.

changes.problem: The plinth tops carry a clipped white band that reads as an LED strip or plastic.

change.setting: the altar's spots, and the lit niche's strip
change.to: 2 x 20.0 W, cone 24 deg, aimed 150 mm higher, onto the cabinets; strip 0.25

changes.expected: The plinth edges hold oak grain and the light falls on the speaker cabinets.

changes.problem: The foreground chair is crushed to a silhouette; the room lacks pools of light between the dark areas.

change.to: 0.05 W (so each table and chair arm sits in its own small warm pool)

changes.expected: The velvet nap reads on the near chair; the tables form pools.

changes.problem: No sign of life reads; the one prop seen, the sleeve, reads as a blank beige card.

evidence.measured: a flat beige rectangle with no print or edge wear

change.from: 1 rocks, 1 votives; a sleeve against a plinth
change.to: a half-full rocks glass and a record out of its sleeve on the nearest oak table, a coat over the foreground tub chair, the leaning sleeve with printed art and a worn edge

changes.expected: The zone reads as in use.

changes.problem: The denoiser smears the acrylic reflections on the horns and cabinets.

evidence.measured: blotchy reflections with no sharp edges in a 3x crop

changes.expected: Clean, undistorted reflections in the horns and sharp cabinet edges.

out_of_scope.request: A stronger smoked tint in the speaker cabinets (they read nearly clear and grey, r82 g68 b69)
out_of_scope.why: The speakers' colour is fixed; if the Smoke configuration is meant to read darker, the model's material should be checked against the product spec, not changed for a picture

out_of_scope.request: Visible Douglas fir beams in the ceiling
out_of_scope.why: If the beams are not in the room's design at this point, adding them is a design change

out_of_scope.request: Two speakers on the altar against the one-coloured-speaker rule
out_of_scope.why: The pair on the altar is fixed by the card
